title: Астероидный рубеж
elevatorPitch: Неоновый VR-шутер обороны космического корабля: взгляд вращает лазерную турель, а 1,5 секунды концентрации взгляда на астероиде превращаются в выстрел.
playerFantasy: Быть живой системой наведения корабля: держать астероид взглядом, пока лазер не будет готов, и не дать потоку пробить корпус.
audience: mobile and desktop casual players with or without lens VR glasses
coreLoop: Look around to rotate the laser turret toward an incoming asteroid
Hold gaze on the asteroid for 1.5 s while the neon dwell ring closes
Laser fires automatically and destroys the asteroid, score increases
Asteroids that reach the ship damage the hull; survive the endless escalating stream as long as possible
perspective: First-person fixed turret position, look direction free within game limits
orientation: landscape for VR stereo; adaptive flat-screen fallback
sessionLength: One endless run; calm escalation reaches maximum density/speed in about 8 minutes
controls: Prep screen chooses look source: gyro VR stereo, camera dual-marker fusion, or flat screen
Gyro: DeviceOrientation quaternion, yaw>0 right, pitch>0 up, rotateY(-yaw) then rotateX(pitch)

Fusion: gyro leads every frame; dual color markers slowly correct drift with confirmation, grace and rate limit; marker entity >=0.15 s; only the pair proves straight; loss holds last look with no timer return to centre
Flat screen: mouse/touch drag or pointer position rotates the turret
Fire: gaze-dwell 1.5 s on one asteroid; progress decays on gaze loss instead of instant reset
Exit VR: Esc, system back (fullscreen exit) or invisible ~0.9 s long-press; zero HUD inside glasses
progression: Endless escalating stream without waves: spawn interval and asteroid speed grow smoothly over about 8 minutes to a capped maximum; score and persistent best score
difficulty: Calm-long escalation; moderate spawn rate; spawn sector strictly yaw ±45 degrees and pitch -30..+30 degrees relative to forward
visualDirection: Neon arcade space: dark starfield, neon laser and explosions, readable asteroid silhouettes, three.js
audioDirection: Minimal synthesized WebAudio: laser shot and explosion only; unlocked after a user gesture; no dwell charge tone by user choice
winCondition: None (endless score survival); personal best score is the goal
loseCondition: Hull reaches 0: each asteroid that reaches the ship deals damage; run ends, score and best are shown on the prep/result screen outside VR
mustHave: Gaze-controlled laser turret with 1.5 s dwell-to-fire and decaying dwell progress shown as a neon ring
Endless moderately escalating asteroid stream spawning only inside the 90x60 degree sector
Hull 100 HP, damage on impact, lose path, score and persistent best
Prep screen with look-source choice (gyro VR stereo / dual-marker camera fusion / flat screen), manual VR quality (high/light, never auto), marker calibration
Zero HUD inside VR glasses; exit via Esc/back/invisible long-press
Camera marker pipeline off the render hot path (Worker with HSV/blob analysis, small frames, busy flag) with explicit fallback
Pause/resume on visibility change; WebAudio unlock after user gesture
Test bridge window.__GAME_TEST__ with seeded reset, state inspection and input simulation
outOfScope: Splitting asteroids and multiple asteroid classes (one type, speed varies)
Physical device certification (device tests reported separately)
acceptanceCriteria: Dwell: holding gaze on one asteroid for 1.5 s fires exactly one shot and destroys it; looking away decays progress without instant reset
Spawn: every asteroid spawns with yaw within ±45 degrees and pitch within -30..+30 degrees and moves toward the player
Hull decreases when an asteroid reaches the ship; hull 0 ends the run and shows score/best outside VR
Escalation: spawn interval and speed increase monotonically and cap at about 8 minutes
Look signs: synthetic gyro poses and marker centroid shifts yield yaw>0 right / pitch>0 up in unit tests
Marker contract: entity requires >=0.15 s visibility; a lone marker never proves straight; pair loss holds look without returning to centre; fusion correction is rate-limited and needs confirmation
VR session DOM contains no HUD/crosshair/buttons overlay; quality stays as manually chosen for the whole session
No blocking console errors; playable at 360x800 and 412x915 flat viewports; pause on visibilitychange
Production build is static, subpath-safe, offline after first load via service worker with separate code/media caches
